summary: zip_longest pairs iterable items until the longest input is exhausted.
documentation: zip_longest pairs iterable items until the longest input is exhausted. Missing positions receive fillvalue, so trailing items are retained rather than silently dropped as they are with ordinary zip.
inputs: An object with left and right lists of JSON values.
returns: A list of two-item lists, using null for a missing position.
caution: Padding with None cannot distinguish a missing position from an actual None value. Choose a separate sentinel in an application that needs that distinction.
scenarios: Align unequal imported columns in a preview.
Compare two lists without dropping unmatched trailing rows.
Pair optional checklist sections while keeping all entries visible.
title: Align unequal lists
problem: Pair left and right by position until both are exhausted. Use null for an exhausted side and return each pair as a JSON list.
hint: Import zip_longest and convert its tuples into lists.
goal: Use itertools.zip_longest() or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
